title: Counting a Game
intro: When both players pass, the game is counted. In Ninepoint, surrounded empty points and prisoners make your score. White also receives komi.

steps.instruction: Close the gap in the corner wall.
steps.hint: The top of the wall, against the edge.
steps.explanation: The wall surrounds nine empty points in this corner. These are territory if White cannot live inside.

steps.instruction: Capture the two white stones inside.
steps.explanation: You gain two prisoners. The vacated intersections can also count as territory when the boundary is secure.

steps.instruction: Close the gap in this larger corner wall.
steps.explanation: This wall surrounds twelve empty points. Compare the space with the smaller corner.

outro: At the count, check the groups marked dead. Change any incorrect marks, then confirm the total. You can review a completed game afterwards.
